hypothesis: A set-aside problem plus a later return note can be stored as a hashed hypothesis. Sleep-onset imagery is not treated as insight, contact, or a sleep-stage measurement.

sources.label: Lacaux et al., Science Advances 2021, eabj5866
sources.observation: In a number-reduction task, participants with at least 15 seconds of N1 during a break discovered a hidden rule more often than a wake group; the paper reports the gain disappeared in N2.
sources.claim: A brief sleep-onset window is a creative sweet spot.
sources.inference: Design material for a set-aside and return-note log. Not a general creativity law and not a reason to ship a sleep detector.

sources.label: Historical object-drop anecdote, cited as a detection trick in Lacaux et al.
sources.observation: Public retellings say Edison and Dali held an object so a drop would wake them near sleep onset.
sources.claim: The drop detects the creative window.
sources.inference: Anecdote only. Void does not ship an audio drop, glove, or wearable.
